PAKISTAN SPORTS BOARD RULES, 1972
PAKISTAN SPORTS BOARD RULES,
1972
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part It, 14th November 1972]
S: R. O. 1103(1)/72.‑In
exercise of the powers conferred by section 4 of the Sports (Development and
Control) Ordinance, 1962 (XVl of 1962), the Federal Government is pleased to
make the following rules for determining
the constitution, powers and functions of the Pakistan Sports Board
constituted under section 3 of the said Ordinance t‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑(1) These rules may be called the Pakistan Sports Board
Rules, 1972.
(2) They shall come into force
at once.
2. Definitions.‑In these
rules, unless there is anything repugnant In the subject or context,‑
(a)
"Board" means the Pakistan Sports Board constituted
under section 3 of the Sports (Development and Control) Ordinance, 1962 (XVI of
1962);
(b) "Executive
Committee" means the Executive Committee of the Board
(c) "Member" means a
member of the Board
(d) "National Games and Sports Organization" means an
organization constituted on a national basis for controlling sports and
recognised as such by the Board ;
(e) "President" means the President of the
Board and includes the Vice‑President and
(f) "Sports" does not
Include horse racing.
3. Terms of office of the members.‑(1)
A member who is a representa tive of a National Games and Sports
Organization shall hold office as long as he continues to represent that
National Games and Sports Organization by virtue of his office in that
Organization.
(2) The nominated, other than
the ex officio, members, shall, unless sooner removed by the Federal
Government, hold office for a term of two years and shall be eligible for
renomination.
4. Headquarters.‑The
Board shall have Its headquarters at such place as may be determined by the
Federal Government.
5. Functions of the Board.‑The following shall be the functions
of the Board, namely :‑‑
(a) to promote and develop
standards of national fitness as well as standards of competition, comparable
to the International standards
(b) to make the public sports‑conscious
and to encourage their participation In the national and international sporting
events ;
(c) to assist and guide the
National Games and Sports Organizations in executing their programmes of
sporting activities.
Note.‑The National Games
and Sports Organizations which are affiliated to their respective International
Games and Sports Organizations must each control its own game throughout the
country ;
(d) to encourage training and coaching of national teams for
interna tional matches
(e) to approve the budget of
the Board
(f) to appoint sub‑committees
as and when It thinks fit and their terms of reference
(g) to encourage, promote and undertake all such measures as
would assist In the development of sports in Pakistan ;
(h) to collect, accept or otherwise receive from any person,
body, asso ciation or organization any subscription, donation, assistance or
help either in money, land or by transfer in favour of the Board ; and
(1) to manage, improve or
otherwise supervise, any property, movable or immovable, with all necessary
powers, in the interests of the Board ; and
(j) to take such disciplinary
action as may be necessary against any Sports Organizations or individuals in
the interests of the game and in order to maintain discipline.
6. Meetings.‑(1) The Board shall meet as and when required.
(2) To constitute a quorum at a
meeting of the Board, not less than one third of the total number of members
shall be present.
(3) The President or, in his
absence, the Vice‑President shall preside at all meetings of the Board
and of the Executive Committee.
(4) At the meetings of the
Board and the Executive Committee each member shall have one vote and, in the
event of equality of votes, the President shall have second or casting vote.
7. Funds.‑(1) The Board shall have its own Funds.
